name: approval-bound-private-session-mining
intent: Extract bounded evidence from approved private transcripts while preserving provenance, minimization, redaction, and revocation boundaries.
successCondition: Stop when every finding is source-labeled within the approved scope and the minimization and retention receipt is complete.
operations: freeze approved file and date scope
minimize and redact content before analysis
record exclusions unresolved ambiguity and revocation handling
preconditions: approval names the private scope purpose and retention
the transcript set belongs to the authorized user or project
positiveTriggers: Mine an explicitly approved private session export for a named question.
Build a source-labeled pattern ledger from a bounded transcript set.
negativeTriggers: Access private sessions without explicit scope and approval.
Infer identity secrets or unrelated personal traits.
failureModes: stop when approval scope or ownership is ambiguous
exclude content unrelated to the named question
terminationConditions: Stop when every finding is source-labeled within the approved scope and the minimization and retention receipt is complete.

measurableImprovement.baseline: the current eternities-mnemosyne route without this exact operational mechanism
measurableImprovement.threshold: all critical cases pass with exact evidence and no authority or effect regression
